entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 同态加密与安全多方计算：协议假设、允许输出与工作负载开销
entries.title_en: Homomorphic encryption and secure multi-party computation: protocol assumptions, permitted output, and workload costs
entries.summary: 同态加密让持钥客户端把输入加密后交服务器计算；MPC 让多方按协议联合计算。机密性来自具体密码假设、参数与腐化模型，仍须保护端点、密钥和实现。允许输出可能透露输入；性能取决于方案、电路与通信，不能给无匹配基准的统一开销倍数。
entries.summary_en: homomorphic encryption lets a key-holding client outsource computation on encrypted inputs; MPC lets parties compute jointly under a protocol. Confidentiality depends on cryptographic assumptions, parameters, and corruption models, with endpoints, keys, and implementations still trusted. Permitted outputs can reveal inputs. Performance depends on scheme, circuit, and communication rather than one overhead multiplier without a matched benchmark.
review_triggers: 密码方案或安全估算器变化
协议腐化合谋模型或性能基准变化
entries.attack_surface: 计算外包 / 模型推理

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 成员推断攻击：给定候选记录，判断它是否进入训练集
entries.title_en: Membership inference: given a candidate record, infer whether it was in training
entries.summary: 成员推断（MIA）通常给定候选记录与模型访问，判断「这条记录是否在训练集」。它的目标是成员身份，不以恢复原文为目标；医院或病种数据集里的成员身份本身就可能敏感。它与训练数据抽取、属性推断是相关但独立的攻击目标，并非这些攻击的必经前置步骤。
entries.summary_en: membership inference (MIA) typically takes a candidate record and model access, and asks whether that record was in training. Its target is membership, rather than recovering original content; membership in a hospital or disease dataset can itself be sensitive. It is related to, but distinct from, extraction and attribute inference, and is not a prerequisite for those attacks.
review_triggers: 成员推断方法变化
候选分布模型输出或基率变化
entries.attack_surface: 模型输出 / 训练成员身份

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 模型抽取与窃取：只靠查询 API，攻击者就能复刻我的功能、甚至套出我的部分参数
entries.title_en: Model extraction & stealing: with query access alone, an attacker can clone my behavior — and even solve for some of my parameters
entries.summary: 预测 / 生成接口可能被用于复刻模型功能或恢复部分结构与参数，但可行性取决于架构、返回粒度和攻击预算。Tramèr 等（2016）在特定判别式 ML 服务复刻功能；Carlini 等（2024）对当时支持 logits / logprobs 与 logit-bias 等条件的接口恢复投影层及隐藏维度，不是全部权重。替身允许离线测试，但是否保留原模型的成员信号或可抽取原文，必须另测，不能从功能保真度推出。
entries.summary_en: prediction / generation interfaces can support functional cloning or recovery of some structure and parameters, depending on architecture, output granularity, and attack budget. Tramèr et al. (2016) cloned specific discriminative ML services; Carlini et al. (2024) recovered projection layers and hidden dimensions under interface conditions involving logits / logprobs and logit-bias, rather than all weights. A surrogate permits offline testing, but retaining the original model’s membership signals or extractable text requires separate evidence; functional fidelity does not establish that.
review_triggers: logits/logprobs/logit-bias接口变化
配额架构或参数抽取攻击变化
entries.attack_surface: 模型查询 API / 预测接口

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 模型反演与属性推断：靠查询与置信度，攻击者能重建训练样本的「样子」、或推断你的敏感属性
entries.title_en: Model inversion & attribute inference: with queries and confidence, an attacker can rebuild what a training sample 'looks like' — or infer your sensitive attributes
entries.summary: 除了「判定某人在不在训练集」（成员推断），推断类攻击还有两支更直接要命的：模型反演——靠反复查询 + 我吐出的置信度，重建出某个类别训练样本的「样子」（Fredrikson 等在 CCS 2015 上从人脸识别模型重建出可辨认的人脸）；属性推断——给定一个人的部分已知信息 + 我，推断出他未公开的敏感属性（Fredrikson 等 2014 的华法林剂量案例）。结论先行：置信度 / 概率输出是燃料，而属性推断还借了人群统计相关性——别以为「没把原始数据发出去」就安全，要看输出粒度、是否叠 DP、以及类别是否对应到单个个体。
entries.summary_en: beyond "deciding whether someone is in the training set" (membership inference), inference attacks have two more direct, dangerous branches: model inversion — using repeated queries + the confidence I emit to rebuild what a class's training sample "looks like" (Fredrikson et al. at CCS 2015 reconstructed recognizable faces from a face-recognition model); and attribute inference — given a person's partial known info + me, inferring their undisclosed sensitive attribute (Fredrikson et al.'s 2014 warfarin-dosing case). Conclusion first: confidence / probability outputs are the fuel, and attribute inference also borrows population-statistics correlations — don't assume "didn't send raw data out" is safe; look at output granularity, whether DP is stacked, and whether a class maps to a single individual.
review_triggers: 反演访问模型或输出粒度变化
敏感人群属性或基线变化
entries.attack_surface: 模型输出 / 置信度

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 属性 / 分布推断：不偷某一条数据，而是套出你训练集的「群体属性」
entries.title_en: Property / distribution inference: not stealing one record, but extracting a 'population property' of your training set
entries.summary: 这条不是判定某人在不在（成员推断），也不是重建某条样本（反演），而是套出我整个训练集的统计属性——「这个模型是用『多少比例女性 / 某族裔』的数据训出来的」。Ganju 等（CCS 2018）用一个元分类器做到了：在美国人口普查收入数据上，能区分「训练集 38% 女性 vs 65% 女性」、「0% 白人 vs 87% 白人」两种构成。Suri & Evans（PoPETs 2022）进一步把它形式化为「分布推断」，并给出 `n_leaked` 指标量化风险。结论先行：训练集的群体构成本身就可能敏感（商业机密 / 群体隐私），别只盯着保护单个个体——有时攻击者要的根本不是某一条记录。
entries.summary_en: this entry isn't about deciding whether someone is in (membership inference) or rebuilding a specific sample (inversion) — it's about extracting a statistical property of my whole training set: "what fraction of women / a given ethnicity was this model trained on." Ganju et al. (CCS 2018) did exactly this with a meta-classifier: on US Census Income data, it distinguishes training sets that are 38% vs 65% women and 0% vs 87% white. Suri & Evans (PoPETs 2022) then formalized it as "distribution inference" and gave the `n_leaked` metric to quantify the risk. Conclusion first: the population makeup of a training set can itself be sensitive (trade secret / group privacy) — don't focus only on protecting a single individual; sometimes the attacker doesn't want any one record at all.
review_triggers: 属性比例或攻击者知识变化
分布推断方法或发布方式变化
entries.attack_surface: 模型参数 / 输出

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 可信执行环境（TEE）：硬件把「使用中的数据」围起来，但信任根是芯片厂商、侧信道仍在
entries.title_en: Trusted execution environments (TEE): hardware fences off data in use — but the root of trust is the chip vendor, and side channels remain
entries.summary: 可信执行环境（TEE）用硬件把「使用中的数据」（data in use）圈进一个加密、可远程证明的飞地（enclave），让同租户、恶意 OS / hypervisor、甚至云运营商都看不到里面——这是把 LLM 的 prompt 与权重对云厂商保密的硬件路线。但记牢两条边界：信任根是芯片厂商及获准的软件/证明策略（包括密钥、实现与端点验证），且 TEE 反复被微架构侧信道攻破（Foreshadow 一类）。它是卷五「机密推理」的承重墙，所以先在卷一交代清楚它保证什么、不保证什么。
entries.summary_en: a trusted execution environment (TEE) uses hardware to fence data in use into an encrypted, remotely attestable enclave, so co-tenants, a malicious OS / hypervisor, even the cloud operator can't see inside — the hardware route to keeping an LLM's prompts and weights confidential from the cloud provider. But hold two boundaries: the root of trust is the chip vendor (you trust Intel / AMD / NVIDIA's keys and implementation), and TEEs have been repeatedly broken by microarchitectural side channels (the Foreshadow family). It's the load-bearing wall for Volume 5's "confidential inference," so Volume 1 spells out up front what it does and doesn't guarantee.
review_triggers: CPU/GPU驱动固件或安全模式变化
证明策略撤销或侧信道公告变化
entries.attack_surface: 运行时数据 / 显存 / CPU-GPU 通道

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 机密推理：硬件、工作负载与验证共同定义边界
entries.title_en: Confidential inference: hardware, workloads, and verification define the boundary
entries.summary: 机密推理用受支持的硬件隔离、远程证明和密钥释放策略减少宿主运营商读取输入/权重的能力。CVM 里的租户软件仍可处理明文，不能从“用了机密 VM”推出应用服务方看不到请求。Apple PCC 将软件透明性和设备端验证组合；其他部署不自动具有同一透明日志架构。
entries.summary_en: confidential inference combines supported hardware isolation, attestation, and key-release policy to reduce host-operator access to inputs/weights. Tenant software inside a CVM still processes plaintext; a confidential VM alone does not establish confidentiality from the application provider. Apple PCC combines software transparency with device verification; other deployments do not automatically have the same transparency-log architecture.
review_triggers: 硬件或产品可用性变化
工作负载证明或密钥释放策略变化
entries.attack_surface: 推理服务 / 云端 prompt 与权重

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 生产级 DP·FL：隐私单位、参与会计与安全聚合的边界
entries.title_en: Production DP-FL: privacy units, participation accounting, and secure-aggregation boundaries
entries.summary: FL 减少集中原始记录，却不自动使上传更新或最终模型私有。DP 限制指定隐私单位对发布结果的贡献，安全聚合限制服务器对单个更新的可见性；是否组合取决于威胁模型。Gboard 2023 论文部署 20 多个 DP 模型，其中 2 个另启安全聚合，不是所有生产配置都使用同一组合。
entries.summary_en: FL reduces centralization of raw records without automatically protecting updates or the final model. DP bounds a defined unit’s contribution to released results; secure aggregation restricts server visibility of individual updates. Their combination depends on the threat model. Gboard’s 2023 paper deploys over 20 DP models, two additionally using secure aggregation, rather than one universal production configuration.
review_triggers: 客户端参与或隐私单位变化
DP 会计或安全聚合生产配置变化
entries.attack_surface: 设备数据 / 模型更新

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 联邦分析：本地统计、聚合视图与 DP 可信边界
entries.title_en: Federated analytics: local statistics, aggregate views, and DP trust boundaries
entries.summary: 联邦分析在设备本地算统计贡献，减少集中原始数据。安全聚合限制服务器看单点，DP 限制指定单位对发布统计的影响；中心 DP、本地 DP 与分布式 DP 有不同可信边界，不是所有私有统计都必须使用同一组合。
entries.summary_en: federated analytics computes local statistical contributions and reduces raw-data centralization. Secure aggregation restricts server views of individuals; DP bounds a defined unit’s influence on released statistics. Central, local, and distributed DP have different trusted boundaries, rather than one mandatory combination for all private statistics.
review_triggers: 查询目的贡献限制或参与规模变化
DP 算法或多轮发布变化
entries.attack_surface: 设备数据 / 聚合统计

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 梯度泄露：联邦学习「只共享梯度不共享数据」挡不住反演——梯度能被还原成训练样本
entries.title_en: Gradient leakage: \"sharing gradients, not data\" doesn't stop inversion — gradients can be reconstructed into training samples
entries.summary: DLG 与 Inverting Gradients 在所测架构、批量和可见更新下重建训练输入，否定“只传梯度就自动私有”。梯度匹配并非总能唯一恢复原文；安全聚合限制单点视图，DP 限制定义单位对发布物的贡献，按威胁模型选用并独立分析。
entries.summary_en: DLG and Inverting Gradients reconstruct training inputs under evaluated architectures, batches, and visible updates, disproving automatic privacy from sharing gradients. Gradient matching does not always uniquely recover the original. Secure aggregation restricts individual views; DP bounds a defined unit’s contribution to releases. Choose and analyze them under the threat model.
review_triggers: 模型批量或局部步数变化
更新视图反演或主动攻击变化
entries.attack_surface: 共享梯度 / 模型更新

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 推理期侧信道：不碰模型，光看流式响应的时序 / 长度就能套出你在聊什么
entries.title_en: Inference-time side channels: without touching the model, just the timing / length of a streamed response leaks what you're talking about
entries.summary: 即使流量全程加密、模型一个字都不多吐，把我部署起来的那套系统——逐 token 流式、按 token 长度分包、跨用户共享缓存——本身就是一条泄露通道。Weiss 等（USENIX Security 2024）只观测每个加密流式 token 的长度，就把一个 AI 助手响应的约 29% 逐字还原、对约 55% 推断出主题（在 OpenAI ChatGPT-4 与 Microsoft Copilot 的浏览器 + API 流量上演示；披露后厂商已打补丁）。Gu 等（ICML 2025）审计 17 家真实 LLM API 提供方，发现 8 家有 prompt 缓存、其中 7 家是跨用户全局共享（含 OpenAI）——攻击者看到一个异常快的响应，就能推断「别人刚刚提交过同一个 prompt」。结论先行：隐私边界要算到部署层 / 网络层 / 缓存层，不只是模型层；否则你以为加密就安全，其实时序和长度在替你说话。
entries.summary_en: even with traffic fully encrypted and the model emitting not one extra word, the system that deploys me — token-by-token streaming, packets segmented by token length, caches shared across users — is itself a leak channel. Weiss et al. (USENIX Security 2024), observing only the length of each encrypted streamed token, reconstructed about 29% of an AI assistant's responses word-for-word and inferred the topic of about 55% (demonstrated on OpenAI ChatGPT-4 and Microsoft Copilot, over both browser and API traffic; vendors patched after disclosure). Gu et al. (ICML 2025) audited 17 real-world LLM API providers and found caching in 8, with global cross-user cache sharing in 7 (including OpenAI) — an attacker who sees an unusually fast response infers that another user recently submitted that exact prompt. Conclusion first: draw the privacy boundary at the deployment / network / cache layer, not just the model layer — otherwise you think encryption makes you safe, while timing and length are speaking on your behalf.

entries.title: 可验证删除与机器遗忘：「删了源数据」不等于「模型忘了」，而「证明真忘了」更难
entries.title_en: Verifiable deletion and machine unlearning: \"deleted the source record\" ≠ \"the model forgot\" — and proving it forgot is harder still
entries.summary: 删掉源记录不自动移除模型对它的依赖。精确遗忘比较同一训练流程在删除后的分布；近似遗忘可有声明的形式界，也可能只有经验方法。用 MIA 或抽取做验证只能寻找反例，不能从未检出证明完整分布等价。
entries.summary_en: deleting a source record does not automatically remove model dependence on it. Exact unlearning compares distributions under the same training procedure after deletion; approximate unlearning may have formal bounds or only empirical evidence. MIA/extraction tests seek counterexamples; non-detection does not prove full-distribution equivalence.

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 端侧推理作为隐私姿态：prompt 不出设备是真的，但「端侧」没覆盖到哪些
entries.title_en: On-device inference as a privacy posture: the prompt really doesn't leave the device — but here's what \"on-device\" doesn't cover
entries.summary: 把模型跑在你自己的设备上，prompt 就不必离开设备——这条路线真能落地（Apple Intelligence 的端侧 ~30 亿参数模型、Google Gemini Nano 经 Android AICore 端侧运行都已发货），也是 [机密推理](./confidential-inference.mdx)「云看不到」之外的互补路线：端侧是「设备不发出去」。但「端侧」是个容易被过度解读的词——真正的边界不在「厂商说端侧」，而在哪些请求仍会回落到云、端侧模型因为更小付了多少能力代价、以及遥测 / 诊断 / 模型下载这些通道。结论先行：「端侧」≠「零外传」；能验证的是「这一路请求确实在本机跑完、prompt 没为这条路径离开设备」，而哪些请求端侧、哪些回落云是一个要去核的部署事实，不是模型的一句承诺。回落云那部分，得回到机密推理去验证。
entries.summary_en: run the model on your own device and the prompt never has to leave it — and this route actually ships today (Apple Intelligence's ~3B-parameter on-device model and Google's Gemini Nano running on-device via Android AICore are both deployed). It's the complement to [confidential inference](./confidential-inference.mdx)'s "the cloud can't see it": on-device means "the device doesn't send it out." But "on-device" is a word that's easy to over-read — the real boundary isn't "the vendor says on-device," it's which requests still fall back to the cloud, how much capability you trade away because the on-device model is smaller, and the telemetry / diagnostics / model-download channels. Bottom line first: "on-device" ≠ "nothing leaves the device." What's verifiable is that a given request completes on the local device and its prompt didn't leave the device *for that path*; but which requests run on-device versus fall back to the cloud is a deployment fact to check, not a model promise. For the fall-back-to-cloud portion, you go back to confidential inference to verify it.

entries.title: 安全聚合：协议假设内限制单点视图，允许输出仍可能泄露
entries.title_en: Secure aggregation: restrict individual views under protocol assumptions; permitted outputs can still leak
entries.summary: 安全聚合让服务器在具体腐化/合谋/掉线模型内得到允许的向量和，而不额外看到诚实客户端的单个更新。允许的和本身仍可能泄露，不能把「学不到任何单点」当无条件结论。Bonawitz 等 CCS2017 完整协议与 MLSys2019 系统提供机制与生产依据；2016 workshop 稿不是同一书目。
entries.summary_en: under a concrete corruption/collusion/dropout model, secure aggregation gives the server a permitted vector sum without additionally exposing honest clients’ individual updates. The permitted sum itself can still leak; “learns no individual contribution” is not unconditional. The full CCS 2017 protocol and MLSys 2019 system provide mechanism and production evidence; the 2016 workshop manuscript is a different publication.

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 拆分学习泄露：把模型切两半「原始数据留在本地」，服务器仍能从中间激活重建你的输入
entries.title_en: Split learning leakage: splitting the model in two so \"raw data stays local\" doesn't stop the server reconstructing your inputs from intermediate activations
entries.summary: 拆分学习把模型从某层切成两半——客户端跑前几层、把中间激活（smashed data）发给服务器跑剩下的——常被说成「原始数据不出本地，所以隐私」。结论先行：这不等于私有。Feature-Space Hijacking Attack（Pasquini 等，CCS 2021）证明，恶意服务器能主动把拆分模型引导进不安全状态，从中间激活重建出客户端的私有训练输入（在 MNIST / Omniglot / CelebA 上重建图像）；UnSplit（Erdoğan 等，WPES@CCS 2022）更表明连诚实但好奇的服务器——只知客户端结构、不需主动干预——也能反演（MNIST / Fashion-MNIST / CIFAR-10 上重建 MSE 随数据与配置变化）。别把「没传原始像素」当隐私。
entries.summary_en: split learning cuts the model at some layer into two halves — the client runs the first few layers and sends the intermediate activations (smashed data) to the server to run the rest — and is often described as "raw data never leaves the client, so it's private." Conclusion first: this is not private. The Feature-Space Hijacking Attack (Pasquini et al., CCS 2021) shows a malicious server can actively steer the split model into an insecure state and reconstruct the client's private training inputs from the intermediate activations (reconstructing images on MNIST / Omniglot / CelebA); UnSplit (Erdoğan et al., WPES @ CCS 2022) shows that even an honest-but-curious server — knowing only the client architecture, with no active interference — can invert (reconstruction MSE varying by data and configuration on MNIST / Fashion-MNIST / CIFAR-10). Don't read "didn't send raw pixels" as privacy.

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 遗忘基准与标准化评测：把「遗忘干净了吗」做成可回归的分数——以及基准本身的盲区
entries.title_en: Unlearning benchmarks and standardized evaluation: turning \"did it forget cleanly?\" into a regression-able score — and the benchmarks' own blind spots
entries.summary: 你跑完一个遗忘算法——现在得证明它有用。标准化基准（RWKU、MUSE、TOFU 家族）把「我们忘了」变成一个可比、可回归的分数：不是单看「还背不背得出」，而是同时量遗忘质量 × 保留效用 × 攻击下的隐私泄露三根轴。这些基准在各自受测设置下显示：不少被测方法难以同时过「效用」和「泄露」两关（MUSE 报告：八个算法里只有一个不导致严重隐私泄露）。但基准本身也有盲区：基准是代理，过基准 ≠ 真忘（接本卷《[遗忘可验证性](./unlearning-verification.mdx)》），覆盖之外是照不到的角落。
entries.summary_en: you ran an unlearning algorithm — now you have to prove it worked. Standardized benchmarks (RWKU, MUSE, the TOFU family) turn "we forgot it" into a comparable, regression-able score: not just "can it still recite it?" but forget quality × retained utility × privacy leakage under attack, three axes at once. Within their respective tested settings, these benchmarks find that many evaluated methods struggle to meet both utility and leakage criteria (MUSE reports that of eight algorithms, only one avoids severe privacy leakage). But the benchmarks have blind spots of their own: a benchmark is a proxy, and passing it ≠ truly forgotten (this picks up this volume's [Unlearning verifiability](./unlearning-verification.mdx)); whatever it doesn't cover is a corner it can't see.

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 机器遗忘的可验证性：删了没法证——模型级遗忘无法验证，甚至能伪造「证明」
entries.title_en: Verifiability of machine unlearning: you deleted it but can't prove it — model-level unlearning is unverifiable, and \"proofs\" can be forged
entries.summary: 跑完遗忘算法、声称某条数据「忘了」，但在单个训练好的模型级别，这件事没法被验证——Thudi 等（USENIX Security 2022）给出伪造（forging）构造：同一组模型参数可以由另一个数据集 / 另一条梯度序列训出，于是模型方能拿一份「我遗忘了」的假证明充数，而实际上那条记录还留着。配套地，TOFU（Maini 等，COLM 2024）把「遗忘质量」做成可测基准，发现没有现成方法能在「遗忘质量 vs 效用」间真正过关。结论先行：遗忘要审计算法 / 过程，不能只盯最终权重；「删了」必须可证，否则是合规假象。
entries.summary_en: you ran an unlearning algorithm and claim some record is "forgotten" — but at the level of a single trained model, that claim can't be verified. Thudi et al. (USENIX Security 2022) give a forging construction: the same model parameters can be produced from a different dataset / a different gradient sequence, so a model owner can pass off a fabricated "I unlearned it" proof while actually keeping the record. Alongside it, TOFU (Maini et al., COLM 2024) turns "forget quality" into a measurable benchmark and finds no off-the-shelf method convincingly passes the "forget quality vs. utility" tradeoff. Conclusion first: audit the algorithm / process, not the final weights; "deleted" must be provable, or it's compliance theater.

entries.title: 数据生命周期与删除传播：删了主库那条记录，不等于数据真的没了
entries.title_en: Data lifecycle & deletion propagation: deleting that row from the primary DB doesn't mean the data is actually gone
entries.summary: 删主库不等于删完日志、备份、缓存、向量与其他派生物。按数据血缘识别删除对象，处理有效请求、合法留存例外与接收方通知，并验证备份恢复后重放删除。GDPR 删除权并非无例外的即时清空；模型参数是否涉及个人数据与如何补救须按个案评估。
entries.summary_en: deleting the primary record does not clear logs, backups, caches, vectors, and other derivatives. Use lineage to identify erasure targets, handle valid requests, lawful retention exceptions and recipient notification, and replay deletion after backup restoration. GDPR erasure is not unconditional instant clearing; whether model parameters involve personal data and how to remedy it require case-specific assessment.

entries.title: 微调即服务隐私：训练资产边界与微调后隐私回归
entries.title_en: Fine-tuning-as-a-service privacy: training-asset boundaries and post-tuning privacy regression
entries.summary: FTaaS 有两组需要独立核实的风险：数据/派生模型在服务方的访问、保留和删除，以及微调后的行为退步。Qi 等 2023 实验显示安全护栏可能受少量恶意或良性微调削弱；这不是已证明每项隐私拒答都下降，更不是训练数据抽取证据。隐私任务须单独回归。
entries.summary_en: FTaaS requires separate checks of provider access/retention/deletion for data and derived models, and post-tuning behavioral regressions. Qi et al.’s 2023 experiments show safety guardrails can weaken under malicious or benign tuning. This does not prove every privacy refusal declines or establish training-data extraction; test privacy tasks separately.

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 推理服务数据边界：「他们不拿去训练」只是一格，要逐项核、且会过期
entries.title_en: Inference-service data boundary: \"they don't train on it\" is one cell — verify each, and it expires
entries.summary: 把私有数据发给第三方推理 API，「他们不拿去训练」往往是真的——但那只是数据边界的一格。还要逐项核：保留多久、滥用监控日志留多久、企业档和消费档差在哪、有没有零数据保留（ZDR）、子处理方是谁、数据落在哪个区域、有没有 DPA/BAA。更要记住：这些条款会变，还可能被法律令推翻。把一句「我们不训练」当成整条边界，是最常见的运营期假安全。
entries.summary_en: sending private data to a third-party inference API, "they don't train on it" is often true — but that's just one cell of the data boundary. You also have to verify, item by item: how long it's retained, how long abuse-monitoring logs are kept, how enterprise vs. consumer tiers differ, whether there's zero data retention (ZDR), who the subprocessors are, which region the data lands in, and whether there's a DPA/BAA. And remember: these terms change, and can be overridden by a legal order. Treating one line — "we don't train on it" — as the whole boundary is the most common operational-phase false security.

entries.title: LLM 水印与数据溯源：概率证据、改写鲁棒性与部署边界
entries.title_en: LLM watermarks and data provenance: statistical evidence, paraphrase robustness, and deployment boundaries
entries.summary: 输出水印用采样统计信号支持生成内容识别；copyright traps 则向训练语料埋受控记号、事后检测训练使用。两者都是条件性的取证证据。改写可能稀释信号，但不是一次改写必能抹除；ICLR 2024 可靠性论文恰好发现，足够长的文本在强改写后仍可能被检出。它们不提供个人数据保密，也不自动证明侵权。
entries.summary_en: output watermarks support generated-content identification through sampling statistics; copyright traps plant controlled markers in training material to test later use. Both provide conditional forensic evidence. Paraphrasing can dilute a signal, but one paraphrase does not necessarily erase it: the ICLR 2024 reliability paper finds detection can survive strong paraphrasing given enough text. Neither provides personal-data confidentiality or automatically establishes infringement.

entries.title_en: Persistent memory: privacy and retention — what a product memory feature keeps across sessions by design, and whether I can control or delete it
entries.summary: 产品记忆把信息按设计带到后续会话，但可读取来源、可见摘要、关闭与删除并非一回事。当前 ChatGPT 文档包含聊天、saved memories、自定义指令、Library 和连接应用等来源，功能因账户 / 地区 / workspace 而异。把记忆作为数据生命周期的一处状态治理，不能把「不再提及」「关闭」「摘要不见了」当成所有来源都已删除。

Current ChatGPT documentation includes chats, saved memories, custom instructions, Library, and connected-app sources, varying by account / region / workspace. Govern memory as lifecycle state; “do not mention,” “off,” or disappearance from a summary does not establish deletion of every source.

entries.title: 合成数据隐私：用合成数据替代真实数据≠匿名——除非有形式化 DP，且仍有效用权衡
entries.title_en: Synthetic-data privacy: replacing real data with synthetic data ≠ anonymous — unless generated under formal DP, and even then a utility trade-off remains
entries.summary: 合成数据不自动匿名，相似度测试可能漏掉成员、属性和重构泄露。DP 可给指定单位的贡献保证，但须覆盖训练、筛选、评估和发布的完整机制；有 DP 不自动等于法律匿名，没有 DP 也不能据此否定所有其他形式定义。
entries.summary_en: synthetic data is not automatically anonymous, and similarity tests can miss membership, attribute, and reconstruction leakage. DP can bound a defined unit’s contribution, but must cover the entire training, selection, evaluation, and release mechanism. DP does not automatically establish legal anonymity, and its absence does not invalidate every other formal definition.

entries.title: DP 审计：你声称的 ε 是真的吗——用一次训练经验下界 DP 保证
entries.title_en: DP privacy auditing: is the ε you claim real? Empirically lower-bound your DP guarantee in one training run
entries.summary: DP 审计用受控成员推断等攻击，给满足指定邻接关系与 δ 的隐私参数 ε 构造统计置信下界，用来寻找声称上界的反例。它不提供形式上界，也不能认证实现无误。一次训练审计可独立随机纳入多条 canary，但共享训练模型的隐私损失 / 判断不因此彼此独立，必须使用相应定理校准。
entries.summary_en: DP auditing uses controlled attacks such as membership inference to construct a statistical lower confidence bound on ε for specified adjacency and δ, looking for counterexamples to a claimed upper bound. It neither supplies a formal upper bound nor certifies the implementation. One-run audits independently randomize canary inclusion, but privacy losses / decisions from a shared trained model are not thereby independent; use the appropriate calibrated theorem.
review_triggers: 审计定理或置信校准变化
邻接δ采样或可见输出变化

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 多模态训练图像抽取：扩散图像近似复制与视觉语言模型成员推断
entries.title_en: Multimodal training-image extraction: diffusion near-copies and vision-language membership inference
entries.summary: 记忆与抽取不只发生在文字上——图像也会。把私有图（患者影像、内部设计稿、有版权的画作）喂进扩散 / 视觉模型微调，在外部攻击者看来，给对提示，我可能生成与某张训练图近乎逐像素一致的图；这种复现可以靠「拿生成图去比对训练集」测出来，而且主要由训练里被重复的图驱动——高重复的图更容易被吐回来。结论先行：别以为「生成模型只会画新图、不会吐原图」，图像域的记忆是真实的，防法与文本记忆同根（去重 + DP + 相似度审计），但代价换成了「近似复制」而非「逐字复制」。
entries.summary_en: memorization and extraction don't only happen to text — images too. Fine-tune a diffusion / vision model on private images (patient scans, internal design assets, copyrighted art), and to an outside attacker, given the right prompt, I may generate an image near-identical, pixel for pixel, to some specific training image; that reproduction is measurable by matching generated images against the training set, and it is driven mostly by images that were duplicated in training — the more duplicated an image, the more likely it comes back out. Conclusion first: don't assume "a generative model only paints new images, it won't emit the originals." Image-domain memorization is real, the defenses share the same root as text memorization (dedup + DP + similarity auditing), but the cost is now "near-copy" rather than "verbatim."
review_triggers: 生成器采样或图文数据变化
图像相似度或 VLM 成员推断变化
entries.attack_surface: 图像生成 / 多模态训练记忆

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 隐私定向投毒：往训练集掺一点「毒」，能放大对其他人的隐私泄露
entries.title_en: Privacy-targeted data poisoning: dripping a little \"poison\" into the training set amplifies privacy leakage about other people
entries.summary: 投毒不只是「破坏完整性」的安全问题——它也是隐私问题。Tramèr 等（*Truth Serum*, CCS 2022）证明：往训练集里掺极少量（< 0.1%）精心构造的投毒样本，能把对别的、没被投毒的记录的成员推断 / 属性推断 / 数据抽取成功率拉高 1–2 个数量级；他们的标志性数字是——只插入 8 条投毒样本进 CIFAR-10（占该实验抽样训练集约 0.03%），就能把某张目标图像的成员推断真正例率（TPR）从 7% 抬到 59%（FPR 0.1% 处）。而 web 级语料投毒便宜可行：买过期域名做「分裂视图」，约 \$60 就能控制 LAION-400M 的约 0.01%（Carlini 等，S&P 2024——这是可行性佐证，本身不是一次隐私泄露结果）。结论先行：训练数据完整性 = 隐私问题；不可信的数据源是隐私放大器。
entries.summary_en: poisoning isn't only an integrity ("corrupt the model") problem — it's a privacy problem too. Tramèr et al. (*Truth Serum*, CCS 2022) show that inserting a tiny amount (< 0.1%) of carefully crafted poison into the training set raises the success of membership inference / attribute inference / data extraction against other, non-poisoned records by 1–2 orders of magnitude; their signature number — inserting just 8 poison samples into CIFAR-10 (about 0.03% of that sampled training set) lifts membership-inference true-positive rate (TPR) from 7% to 59% (at 0.1% FPR) for a targeted image. And web-scale poisoning is cheap and practical: by buying expired domains for a "split-view," you can control ~0.01% of LAION-400M for ~\$60 (Carlini et al., S&P 2024 — this is a feasibility result, not itself a privacy-leak result). Conclusion first: training-data integrity = a privacy problem; an untrusted data source is a privacy amplifier.

目标知识或 DP 保护单位变化

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 量化记忆与记忆审计：用探针（canary）和暴露度，在发布前量出我「记住了多少」
entries.title_en: Quantifying memorization and memorization auditing: use canaries and exposure to measure how much I 'memorized' before release
entries.summary: 「我到底记住了多少私有数据」不该靠感觉，它可以量出来。Secret Sharer（USENIX Security 2019）给了方法：往训练集插入随机的探针（canary），训练后用暴露度（exposure）量它相对随机串被我偏好的程度——暴露度越高，说明记得越牢。Quantifying Memorization（ICLR 2023）进一步测出：模型越大、某条重复越多、给的上下文越长，可发现的记忆越多。结论先行：发布前用 canary + exposure 审计记忆，把「记住了多少」变成可回归的数字，别凭直觉说「应该没记住」——那是审计缺位的假安全。
entries.summary_en: "how much private data did I actually memorize" shouldn't be a gut feeling — it can be measured. The Secret Sharer (USENIX Security 2019) gives the method: insert random canaries into the training set, then use exposure to measure how strongly I prefer each one over random strings — higher exposure means it's memorized harder. Quantifying Memorization (ICLR 2023) goes further and measures: the bigger the model, the more a sequence is duplicated, and the longer the context, the more discoverable memorization there is. Conclusion first: audit memorization with canaries + exposure before release, turning "how much got memorized" into a regression-able number — don't say "it probably didn't memorize anything" on a hunch, which is the false security of a missing audit.
review_triggers: 候选空间排名估计或注入策略变化
模型族或抽取攻击变化
entries.attack_surface: 训练记忆 / 审计探针

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 训练数据去重：把重复样本删掉，能把记忆与抽取风险压下去一大截——但不是形式保证
entries.title_en: Training-data deduplication: deleting duplicate samples cuts memorization and extraction risk a lot — but it isn't a formal guarantee
entries.summary: 训练数据里的重复是记忆与抽取的「放大器」。Kandpal 等（ICML 2022）实测：隐私攻击的成功很大程度来自语料的重复，且我重新生成某条序列的概率与它在训练集里的出现次数呈超线性——一条出现 10 次的序列，平均被生成的频率是只出现 1 次的约 1000 倍。Lee 等（ACL 2022）发现现有语料含大量近重复，去重后我逐字吐出记忆文本的频率降到约 1/10，还省训练步数。结论先行：去重是性价比极高的一招，能把记忆 / 抽取 / 成员推断风险压下去一大截；但它降的是频率与概率，不是形式保证——只出现一次的罕见样本仍可能被记住，要形式保证得叠 DP。
entries.summary_en: duplication in training data is the amplifier of memorization and extraction. Kandpal et al. (ICML 2022) measured that the success of privacy attacks largely comes from corpus duplication, and that the probability I regenerate a sequence is superlinear in its count in the training set — a sequence appearing 10 times is generated on average about 1000× more often than one appearing once. Lee et al. (ACL 2022) found existing corpora contain many near-duplicates, and after deduplication I emit memorized text verbatim about 10× less often, with fewer training steps. Conclusion first: dedup is a high-return move that cuts memorization / extraction / membership-inference risk a lot; but it lowers frequency and probability, not a formal guarantee — a rare sample appearing once can still be memorized; for a formal guarantee, stack DP.
review_triggers: 去重算法阈值或增量语料变化
训练预算或 DP 邻接定义变化
entries.attack_surface: 训练语料 / 重复样本

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 训练数据抽取：喂进训练的私有数据，外部攻击者可能让我逐字吐回来
entries.title_en: Training-data extraction: private data you train on, an attacker may get me to spit back verbatim
entries.summary: 「把私有数据喂进训练，它只会变成统计规律、抽不出来」是个危险的错觉。在外部攻击者看来，即使一段文本只在训练里出现过（哪怕只在一个文档里），只要它够罕见、够独特、格式固定，在已有研究设置下就观察到过被逐字抽取的风险——而且已有测量显示：模型容量越大、它重复得越多、给的上下文越长，可发现的记忆就越多。
entries.summary_en: "Train on private data and it just becomes statistics — you can't get it back out" is a dangerous illusion. To an outside attacker, even if a piece of text appeared in training only once (even in a single document), as long as it's rare, distinctive, and fixed-format enough, verbatim extraction has been observed in existing research settings — and measurements show: the larger the model, the more often it was duplicated, and the more context you give, the more discoverable memorization there is.
review_triggers: 模型端点或查询限额变化
抽取方法或语料来源证据变化
entries.attack_surface: 训练数据

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: Agent 隐私评测：从越范围采集、内部共享到注入外泄
entries.title_en: Agent privacy evaluation: acquisition, internal sharing, and injected exfiltration
entries.summary: Agent 隐私评测不能只看「最后有没有外发」。我可能读进了任务不需要的数据、把数据交给无权接收的 agent、或在后续动作里泄露，而最终答案仍然干净。AgentDojo 测注入外泄；PrivacyPeek 和 AgentPrivArena 将视野前移到采集与执行轨迹。上线前应同时量任务完成、越范围采集、未授权共享与对外泄露。
entries.summary_en: agent privacy evaluation cannot stop at “was anything sent out at the end?” I may read data the task does not need, share it with an unauthorized agent, or expose it in a later action while giving a clean final answer. AgentDojo tests injected exfiltration; PrivacyPeek and AgentPrivArena extend scrutiny to acquisition and execution trajectories. Measure task completion, out-of-scope acquisition, unauthorized sharing, and external disclosure together.

evidence_or_threat_model_change

entries.attack_surface: Agent 采集 / 内部传播 / 注入外泄

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: Agent 工具外联数据外泄：藏在内容里的一段指令，就可能驱使我把私有上下文经工具发出去
entries.title_en: Agent tool-use exfiltration: one instruction hidden in content can drive me to send private context out through a tool
entries.summary: Agent 读取不可信内容又能调用工具或渲染外链时，注入可能把私有上下文带出。CamoLeak 历史披露与 2026 Auto Mode 实验红队支持这一攻击面，包括跨上下文、压缩与子 agent。权限、出站目的和数据接收授权须由可信系统约束，不能只靠模型承诺。
entries.summary_en: an agent that reads untrusted content and calls tools or renders external links may send private context out through injection. Historical CamoLeak disclosure and the 2026 Auto Mode red-team experiment support this surface, including cross-context, compaction, and subagent paths. Trusted systems must constrain permissions, egress destinations, and data-recipient authorization rather than relying on model promises.
review_triggers: 工具渲染器权限或监控覆盖变化
跨 agent 压缩摘要或外泄攻击变化
entries.attack_surface: Agent 工具调用 / 外联通道

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: Computer-use 屏幕捕获隐私：实际捕获的显示、窗口或区域可能超出任务所需
entries.title_en: Computer-use screen-capture privacy: the captured display, window, or region can exceed the task’s needs
entries.summary: GUI agent 会把捕获的界面内容作为模型输入；点击的是任务按钮，不代表图片只含任务所需数据。但捕获范围取决于 host：整块 display、专用 VM、浏览器视口、窗口或局部区域，不能一概说成用户宿主桌面的整屏。先核实际 payload 与授权捕获面，再在发送前清场、隔离或遮挡无关敏感内容。
entries.summary_en: GUI agents send captured interface content to the model; clicking a task button does not mean the image contains only task-required data. The host determines the surface: a display, dedicated VM, browser viewport, window, or region. Do not equate them all with the user’s entire host desktop. Check actual payloads and authorized surfaces, then isolate, clear, or mask unrelated sensitive content before sending it.
review_triggers: vendor_documentation_change
permission_or_runtime_change
entries.attack_surface: computer-use 截屏 / 屏幕上下文

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 跨会话 / 跨租户记忆串味：共享的记忆 / 缓存若不按用户隔离，我会把一个人的数据端给另一个人
entries.title_en: Cross-session / cross-tenant memory bleed: shared memory / cache without per-user isolation, and I hand one person's data to another
entries.summary: 共享会话/记忆/缓存若失去身份与权限绑定，可能把 A 的数据返回 B。OpenAI2023 事故中 1.2% 是特定 9 小时活跃 Plus 订户付款信息可能暴露的范围，不等于这些数据全部被实际看到。隔离靠系统认证、授权、连接并发安全与归属校验，不靠模型口头承诺。
entries.summary_en: shared sessions/memory/caches can return A’s data to B if identity and permission binding fail. In OpenAI’s 2023 incident, 1.2% describes possible payment-data exposure among Plus subscribers active in a specific nine-hour window, not confirmed viewing of every record. Isolation relies on system authentication, authorization, pool concurrency, and ownership checks, not model promises.
review_triggers: 身份缓存键或权限变化
连接池取消逻辑或存储版本变化
entries.attack_surface: 会话 / 记忆 / 缓存存储

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 嵌入反演：把文本变成向量不等于匿名——向量能被还原回原文、甚至逐字
entries.title_en: Embedding inversion: turning text into a vector is not anonymization — vectors can be recovered back to the original text, sometimes verbatim
entries.summary: 文本向量不自动匿名。Song 与 Raghunathan 在所测句嵌入上报告词集恢复 F1 约 0.5–0.7；vec2text 在指定 GTR-base、32-token 输入与迭代攻击设置中达到 92% 逐字恢复。指标、编码器、文本长度与对手能力不同，不能合并成所有向量的统一泄露率。
entries.summary_en: text vectors are not automatically anonymous. Song and Raghunathan report word-set recovery F1 around 0.5–0.7 for evaluated sentence embeddings; vec2text reaches 92% exact recovery for specified GTR-base, 32-token inputs and iterative attacks. Different metrics, encoders, lengths, and adversary capabilities do not form one leakage rate for all vectors.
review_triggers: 编码器向量精度或反演攻击变化
导出权限或存储加密边界变化
entries.attack_surface: 文本嵌入 / 向量库

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: MCP 数据流与最小采集：接上一个 MCP server，我的哪些私有上下文被交出去、谁在过度采集
entries.title_en: MCP data flow and least collection: when I connect an MCP server, which slice of my private context gets handed over, and who over-collects
entries.summary: 接上 MCP server，要核的不是「我会不会自觉保密」，而是哪些参数、资源和后续补充输入实际交给了谁。普通 `tools/call` 不会因协议要求自动附上整段对话；过量传递来自工具参数、host 实现、额外能力或 server 的下游访问。把每条数据流、凭据范围和留存方列清，再按任务最小化。2026-07-28 的无状态协议核心也不代表应用不保存数据：状态句柄、重试输入和缓存仍各有隐私边界。
entries.summary_en: connecting an MCP server requires checking which arguments, resources, and follow-up inputs actually reach which party. An ordinary `tools/call` does not automatically include the conversation by protocol requirement; excess sharing comes from arguments, host behavior, additional capabilities, or downstream access. Inventory the flows, credential scopes, and retention parties, then minimize by task. The 2026-07-28 stateless protocol core does not mean the application stores no data: handles, retry inputs, and caches still have privacy boundaries.
review_triggers: vendor_documentation_change
permission_or_runtime_change
entries.attack_surface: MCP host↔server 数据流 / 上下文采集范围

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 多智能体内部信道泄露：最终回答之外，每一跳都要核任务与授权
entries.title_en: Multi-agent internal-channel leakage: audit task and recipient permissions at every hop
entries.summary: 私有数据在多个 agent 间流转时，最终回答干净，不代表内部消息、共享记忆和工具参数没有越界。AgentLeak 在其编排器–worker 设置里测到内部信道比最终输出更易泄露；其他基准分别研究正常协作和对抗对话。工程上要逐跳检查「任务是否需要、接收者是否有权」，而不是把所有敏感字段传递都判违规。
entries.summary_en: when private data moves among agents, a clean final answer does not establish that messages, shared memory, and tool arguments respected its boundaries. AgentLeak finds higher internal-channel leakage in its coordinator–worker setting; other benchmarks study benign collaboration or adversarial dialogue. Check each hop for task appropriateness and recipient authorization instead of treating every sensitive-field transfer as a violation.

evidence_or_threat_model_change

entries.attack_surface: agent 间内部信道 / 共享记忆 / 工具参数

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 持久记忆投毒：外部材料里的指令被存成偏好，下一次会话才把数据送出去
entries.title_en: Persistent memory poisoning: an external instruction becomes a preference and leaks data next session
entries.summary: 攻击者不必直接改我的记忆库。他可以把指令藏进我会读取的外部材料，诱导系统把它存成跨会话规则，等下一次正常任务再触发外泄。边界要守在记忆写入、来源保留与后续动作授权三处；新开聊天不会自动清掉已存的恶意规则。
entries.summary_en: an attacker need not edit my memory store directly. Instructions hidden in external material can be stored as a persistent rule and trigger exfiltration during a later legitimate task. Defend memory writes, preserve provenance, and authorize later actions independently; a new conversation does not automatically remove a poisoned rule.
review_triggers: source_revision
evidence_or_threat_model_change
entries.attack_surface: 不可信外部材料 / 记忆写入与再检索 / 后续工具动作

entries.subject: privacy
entries.title: 多租户 RAG 检索泄露：向量不是匿名，按用户过滤也未必是隔离
entries.title_en: Multi-tenant RAG retrieval leakage: vectors aren't anonymous, and filtering by user isn't always isolation
entries.summary: 多租户 RAG 的隐私边界由认证身份、文档授权、检索/重排/上下文和缓存共同决定。向量不是匿名化，namespace 也不是调用者授权。过滤要在越权内容离开可信边界前生效；检索服务内部的 post-filter 不自动等于泄露，更不能把 Azure security trimming 一概称为应用层后过滤。
entries.summary_en: multi-tenant RAG privacy depends on authenticated identity, document authorization, retrieval / re-ranking / context, and caches together. Vectors are not anonymization, and namespaces do not authorize callers. Filter before unauthorized content leaves the trusted boundary; post-filtering inside a trusted retrieval service is not inherently a disclosure, and Azure security trimming is not invariably application-side post-filtering.
review_triggers: ACL 租户 API 或 RLS 角色变化
重排日志缓存或产品资格变化
entries.attack_surface: 检索库 / 向量库

entries.title: 工件 · LLM 厂商数据边界核查清单
entries.title_en: Artifact · LLM vendor data-boundary checklist
entries.summary: 把《推理服务数据边界》里的核查清单扶成可直接用的工件——按厂商填、打日期、按季度复核。
entries.summary_en: The checklist from "Inference-service data boundary" promoted to a usable artifact — fill one per vendor, date-stamp it, review quarterly.
